author: Kif Leswing
title: There's a hidden message in Apple's new privacy logo - and you can't unsee it (AAPL)
text: There’s a hidden message in Apple’s new privacy logo — and you can’t unsee it (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Jan 25, 2018, 4:59 pm Apple has a new icon that it will display when the company is collecting personal information. Apple's new privacy warnings will start showing up in the next major iPhone update, which will be released this spring. Apple's new privacy logo is two people holding hands — but if you squint, it…
